about: teacher_training Amendment 4 (reports/plans/2026-10-23_plan_teacher-training.md -> 'Amendment 4'): E34's six teachers regenerated (fine-tune seed 0); arms A (task windows, Adam 1e-5, batch 32) and B (Pile train rows from 32,768, batch 8, plain mean KL, Adam 1e-5) retrained at batch-order seed 1 for 1000 steps and read at step 1000 through the harness; then E20 Amendment 3's budget sweep (128 Pile val rows, batches of 8, n sign steps of 2/n for n in 20, 160, adversary seed 0) at W0 (seeds 0, 1), each teacher's do-nothing state and each seed-1 student. RunPod H100. Filed before any run

controls.C1_w0: first, alone: W0 under the Pile harness (256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary) on adversary seeds 0, 1, 2; faith_score.w0_check. Expected: pass, floor about 0.075 on an H100 (pass <= 1.40, fail >= 1.61). Fails: stop, nothing trained
controls.C1b_w0_budget: before any state: the budget sweep at W0 under adversary seeds 0 and 1 at 20 and 160 steps. No gate (W0's ratio to itself is 1). Reported: KL(seed 1) / KL(seed 0) per budget, the noise floor of the budget measure (E31 on the L40: 1.07 at 20 steps, 1.21 at 160; E20 A3: W0 seed 0 0.660 at 20, 0.709 at 160)
controls.G1_r1_sgd_teacher: the first teacher regenerated (r1_t534_v369, SGD 0.03, seed 0, step 1000) reproduces E34's reading: held-out P(target) within 0.01 of 0.983 and size within 0.002 of 0.0287 (E34 also read damage 0.056). Fails: stop before any student

expected.W0: 1 on every ratio; P(target) 0.004 emoticon, 0.15 r0, 0.04 r1
expected.budget_time: E31 on the L40: 20 steps 33 s, 160 steps a further 226 s per state; an H100 about half
expected.do_nothing: the teacher: E34's reproduction readings (P 0.94-1.0, damage 0.008-0.076, size 0.012-0.034), its harness verdict (pass r0 both, emoticon SGD; inconclusive r1 both, emoticon Adam), Delta share 1
expected.seed_1_copies: within the noise of E34's seed-0 copies (P 0.90-1.0, adversarial 0.90-1.37, all 'pass')

measurements.budget: gamma.pgd_sources(model, batches, n, step_size=2/n, seed=0) on the first 128 Pile val rows in batches of 8, then cancel.masked_kl under the sources found; n in (20, 160), each its own run from the seed's random start. Ratio = KL(state) / KL(W0, adversary seed 0) at the same n, relative. W0: 1 by definition; do-nothing: the teacher's own reading (no reference: E34 read the teachers only under the 256-row 20-step harness, 0.98-1.59). Pass line 1.241 (E20 A3's P10). Blind to other adversary families (per-row masks, restarts), budgets past 160, one adversary seed per state. Positive control: the three teachers E34 read inconclusive (r1 SGD 1.59, r1 Adam 1.52, emoticon Adam 1.50) should sit above 1.241 at 20 steps. Noise: W0 seed 1 / seed 0 per budget (C1b)
measurements.harness: E34's seven per state at step 1000 (run.record through read_state, pile=True): adversarial and stochastic ratio to this job's W0 (256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary, seed 0), verdict (faith_score.state_verdict against the same-job floor, p_min 0.9), held-out P(target), teacher gap, damage elsewhere, size, Delta's share. Definitions and expected values as results/predictions.json
measurements.p_target_100: P(target) at step 100 from the training curve's free held-out reading (curve[99]['heldout_p_o'], arm A's eval against W0 at every step); the step-100 state is not saved or read by the harness
